meta.title: Two Hierarchies, One Matrix: Financial Markets vs Drivers
meta.subtitle: Financial markets (rows) vs economic and technology drivers (columns). Each cell = relevance of that driver to that asset, 0 to 100.
meta.score_definition: 0 = no relevance, 100 = the driver is a primary determinant of the asset.
